description: Reconstruction accepts incomplete column groups and derives its row stride from the truncated grid.
actual_behavior: The inherited cols/8 launch truncation and grid-derived stride leave storage unwritten and use an incorrect layout for partial column groups. At 210 torch.empty replaces torch.zeros, so the unwritten part ceases to have a zero fallback.

introductions.rationale: Root tree constructor has no width-divisibility guard; native wrapper checks dimensional ratios only, launches cols/8 blocks, and kernel derives blocks_n from gridDim.x.

finding.description: A previously unguarded partial-width reconstruction can now return unwritten allocation contents.
finding.trigger: Construct LinearEXL3 with compatible scales, in_features=32, out_features=144 and an int16 trellis of shape (2,9,16), then call get_inner_weight_tensor with valid device storage.
finding.expected_behavior: Reject unsupported dimensions or reconstruct every element using the actual output stride.
finding.actual_behavior: The inspected constructor and native shape checks permit these dimensions. The kernel launches one column block, uses a 128-element row stride and writes only 4096 of 4608 allocated elements; the remaining storage is no longer initialized to zero.
